name: Budapest University of Technology and Economics

tuition.note: Per semester for non-EU students in most BSc programmes, 2026/27 (Mechanical Engineering 3,500 EUR); fees vary by programme

requirement.text: High school certificate, English at B2 level (IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72 or equivalent), electronic e-admission exam or placement test, minimum age 18 at enrolment; weaker maths, physics, chemistry or English may mean a one-year preparatory course. Application fee EUR 150.
